summary_zh: gstack 是一套面向 Claude Code 及其他编码助手的斜杠命令工具集，把产品、设计、工程、QA、安全和发布等角色引入开发流程：帮用户重新审视产品定位、审查计划与代码、发现能过 CI 却在生产环境出错的缺陷、用真实浏览器做 QA，并联通测试与 PR 提交。
audience_zh: 适合希望用结构化角色而非空白提示词的 Claude Code（及其他编码助手）新用户，希望仍能亲自交付的技术型创始人/CEO，以及需要在每个 PR 上做严格评审、QA 和发布自动化的技术负责人和资深工程师。

evidence.quote: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

gstack turns Claude Code (and other coding agents) into a virtual engineering team: a CEO who rethinks the product, an eng manager who locks architecture, a designer who catches AI slop, a reviewer who finds production bugs, a QA lead who opens a real browser, a security officer who runs OWASP + STR
- **Founders and CEOs** — especially technical ones who still want to ship
- **First-time Claude Code users** — structured roles instead of a blank prompt
